footprint.notes: The FY2025 10-K (year ended Nov 2, 2025) gives employees only as regional percentages (North America 49%, Asia 36%, EMEA 15% of ~33,000); headcounts were not derived. Item 2 splits facilities over 100,000 sq ft only into United States (3,655,412 sq ft) and Other Countries (2,810,573 sq ft), so no country rows. The 10-K also says a significant majority of R&D personnel are in the U.S. and India, without numbers. Broadcom publishes EU public country-by-country tax reports (with employees by jurisdiction) on investors.broadcom.com, but that host returned 403 Access Denied to every fetch when this lens was first built, so they are not used. No state-level data found. Sites are from the FY2025 10-K's own descriptions; the Singapore row cites the manufacturing sentence because its description is the company's generic wording.
